sloka: अद्य निर्वानरामुर्वीं हत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।करिष्ये परमप्रीतिमित्युक्त्वा ऽन्तरधीयत ।। ६.८०.१८ ।।
transliteration: adya nirvānarāmurvīṁ hatvā rāmaṁ salakṣmaṇam।kariṣye paramaprītimityuktvā 'ntaradhīyata ।। 6.80.18 ।।

translations.english: 'Making the earth devoid of monkeys, killing Rama and Lakshmana, I will provide supreme joy to my father now', saying so he became invisible.
